name: Soulforge Aptitude
descriptionTemplate:
This Talent only takes effect in {Astral Reign} Stages.
This Awakener's CON, Attack, and DEF are increased by [Arg1]%, and after this Awakener plays {Rouse} for the first time, they gain [Arg2] Keyflare.
{Mundus Severance} enjoys an additional [Arg3]% {STR} Bonus. After killing an enemy, gain [Arg4] Black Sigils, which enjoys Lotan: Cetarchon's Sigil Yield Bonus. Takes effect up to once per battle.
